documents.title: Receipt Of Trading Approval For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Face Value Rs. 2/- Each

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a revenue of over 700 crores in Q1 FY27, achieving its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%. The company experienced volume disruptions in April and May due to trade route issues but saw normalization in June, leading to a volume growth guidance of 12% to 15% for the year. Management proposed a capex of 40 crores over the next two years (FY27 and FY28) and is progressing with a corporate restructuring to demerge its copper business into a new entity, Tieramet Limited. Bhagyanagar India Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial results, with revenue from operations reaching Rs. 70,507.54 lakhs and an EBITDA margin of 5.43%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain its EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% going forward in the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: The company targets an export contribution of somewhere between 12% and 15% this year.
guidance.quote: One moment. It will be a minimum of 10%, but we are targeting more towards 15%, so we are looking at somewhere between 12% and 15% this year.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of reaching 5,000 crores of revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: The company expects its volume growth to be a minimum of 15% to 20% every year.
guidance.quote: Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

guidance.claim: The demerged copper company is planned to reach 5,000 crores in 3 years.
guidance.quote: The Demerge Company, which will have only the copper business, will reach 5,000 crores in 3 years.

guidance.claim: The company plans to increase its value-added products share to 66% by the end of next year.
guidance.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees strong demand, with existing customers looking to increase volumes and double capacity in the next 3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As of today, we see a lot of demand. All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has expanded its export portfolio, exporting more than 100 tons of bus bars to North America last quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: We have also expanded our export portfolio. In the last quarter itself, we have exported more than 100 tons of bus bars to North America and we are also exporting a lot of transformer products all over the world.

demand_outlook.claim: The recycled copper market in India is projected to grow at a CAGR of about 12-13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: World copper consumption is predicted to reach 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

demand_outlook.claim: Copper industry growth will be driven by EV and automotive, power and electrification, and renewable energy.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth will mainly be driven by three sectors, EV and automotive. Because, EV requires a lot more copper than regular cars, power and electrification is also a big growth factor, and renewable energy.

demand_outlook.claim: The company foresees a big shortage of copper coming after 3 or 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: The availability, while right now there is no shortage for the next 2 or 3 years for copper. But we foresee a big shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has finished adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is now online.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects its 10,000 ton capacity expansion to become operational between April and June of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to form a new wholly owned subsidiary called Tieramet Limited to hold its copper infrastructure and businesses.
capex_expansion.quote: We are going to form a new company called Tieramet Limited, which will be a wholly owned subsidiary of Bhagyanagar India.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's CTC wire capacity is roughly 80 metric tons a month and will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.
capex_expansion.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has a capacity expansion underway.
The company is proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding recycling verticals of aluminium and plastic.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are also adding recycling verticals of aluminium and plastic.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and highest PAT margin of 2.87% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved a revenue of over 700 crores. We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: The company was able to increase its margins in the first two months of the quarter due to trade route disruptions and material shortages.
margins_costs.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company's margins are more stable in percentage terms than in rupees per kilo terms.
margins_costs.quote: So, our margins are going to be more stable in percentage terms than in rupees per kilo terms.

margins_costs.claim: The removal of customs duty from January 1, 2025, has helped the company increase its margins.
margins_costs.quote: Also, the customs duty has been removed from 1st January 2025, so that has also helped us increase our margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margin for Q1FY27 was 5.43%.
The company's PAT margin for Q1FY27 was 2.87%.
The company's margins have increased due to a shift in mindset toward value-added products.
margins_costs.quote: So, since we have made a shift in our mindset of going into value-added products, our margins have increased a lot.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved around 62 rupees per kg EBITDA in quarter four.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's sales volume dropped to 5,278 tons in Q1 FY27, representing a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Our sales volumes have dropped, though; they have gone to 5,278 tons, which is a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and a 6.5% decrease from last year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved sales volumes of 5,200 tons in the quarter, with 2,200 tons coming in the month of June.
orders_capacity.quote: However, for the whole quarter, our volume has come down to 5,200 tons. But the good part of this is that 2,200 tons of the 5,200 tons has come only in the month of June.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has finished adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's CTC wire capacity is roughly 80 metric tons a month and will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.
orders_capacity.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's capacity has reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's copper sales volume grew by 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has finalized the first round of fundraising at 52 crores, with the money expected in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans a second tranche of fundraising around March, after the demerger is completed.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's long-term projections show that its debt will be between 300 and 350 crores in 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's cash flow is significant and will be more than enough to fund it through 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: Our cash flow is also quite significant, given our 5% EBITDA margin, which is coming every year, and which will be more than enough to fund us through 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is undertaking a preferential issue of Rs. 52.25 Crores to non-promoters.
The company's board approved the preferential issue on June 30, 2026.
Under the scheme of arrangement, BCPL merges into BIL and is dissolved without winding up.
capital_allocation.quote: Amalgamation: BCPL merges into BIL; dissolved without winding up

capital_allocation.claim: The company's working capital has increased from 157 crores to 230 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The increase in equity was done through retained earnings rather than dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is planning to separate into a copper business and a real estate business.
capital_allocation.quote: And, as the merger, as my dad has already mentioned, we're planning to separate our company into a copper business and all our lands into real estate, so we can streamline both the processes and work on them.

risks_headwinds.claim: A GST case was put on the company because of the retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced disruption in April and May due to trade route disruptions and material shortages.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's hedging margin on MCX depends on copper prices, and if copper prices double, it will require a lot of funds.
risks_headwinds.quote: If the copper price doubles, yes, we will definitely require a lot of funds for the MCX margin.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing from Gulf has come down and sourcing from other countries has slowed due to transshipment in and around Gulf.
risks_headwinds.quote: Whatever sourcing from Gulf has come down. Sourcing from other countries has slowed down because of transshipment in and around Gulf.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's volume in the first quarter might be marginally lower than the fourth quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: My volume in the first quarter might be marginally lower than fourth quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing will be a challenge in recycling going forward due to competition.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, Adani and Hindalco announcing that they'll come into recycling is also going to be an issue going forward in future, because one of the biggest challenges in recycling is also sourcing.
